_about: Time loop: one day repeats; knowledge carries over, nothing else. Designed by us. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

trigger: when the bell rings at noon
anchor: a coin that does not reset
breaker: the loop ends on its own after a number of days
